subject: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation timeline, retention window & terms adjustment
messages:
From: Julia Summers <julia.summers@finrite.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, procurement@finrite.com
Date: Tue, 7 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal audit: SOC 2 re-attestation & retention window

Hi Irene,

Thanks — we're kicking off our renewal prep for Finrite Payments (renewal target: 2027-07-15) and need to firm up the SOC 2 re-attestation plan. A couple of ask items from our side: 

- Can Redwood extend the default audit log retention window from 90 days to 180 days for our account for the next 12-month term?
- What is the preferred delivery mechanism for bulk evidence (S3 presigned link vs. shared Drive vs. secure SFTP)? We need instructions and a short checklist so our internal audit team can stage files properly.
- We are also evaluating a modest capacity increase (2 dedicated nodes) as part of the renewal; would that change evidence scope or data-handling commitments?

I've attached last year's SOC 2 report for reference. If possible, could we get an initial timeline and a suggested evidence handoff plan by EOD Thursday?

Thanks,
Julia Summers
Director, Compliance Programs
Finrite Payments

Attachment: Finrite_SOC2_2026.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Julia Summers <julia.summers@finrite.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jun 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal audit: SOC 2 re-attestation & retention window

Julia —

Appreciate the context and the SOC2 PDF. High level response and plan below: 

- Retention window: we can agree to a 180-day audit-log retention for the 12-month renewal term. We'll capture the change as a term amendment and include a retention appendix.
- Evidence delivery: our recommended flow is a staged S3 bucket with time-limited presigned URLs + a shared index spreadsheet; we can also accept a secured Drive folder if your audit team prefers. I'll attach the evidence staging checklist.
- Capacity uplift: adding dedicated nodes doesn't change the scope of SOC 2 evidence materially; it does require an updated capacity appendix (simple addendum). No additional attestation language needed, but we'll document the topology in the evidence bundle.

Proposed immediate timeline:
1) This week (by Thu 2027-06-10): Redwood sends evidence staging checklist and template; confirms retention amendment language for legal.
2) Week of 2027-06-14: evidence handoff window opens for your auditors; kickoff call to align handoff owners.
3) Prior to renewal (by 2027-07-10): finalize term amendment & capacity addendum; collect signatures.

I'll loop in Legal and Sales to draft the amendment and a pricing sketch for the node increase.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_instructions.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Julia Summers <julia.summers@finrite.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal audit: SOC 2 re-attestation & retention window

Hi Julia — quick follow-up from CS side.

Thanks for the heads up. A couple operational notes and requests to make the evidence handoff smooth: 
- Please provide a point of contact for your auditors and a preferred S3 prefix so we can pre-provision the bucket and policy.
- We recommend staging logs in daily batches (zipped) and including a short manifest CSV (timestamp, object_path, sha256).
- If you move forward with the 2-node capacity bump, please indicate expected steady-state QPS and peak burst (QPS) so we can size prefixing and KV cache behavior in the evidence exports.

I'll attach a small runbook template for handoff and an example manifest. If you can fill that out ahead of the kickoff call it'll save time.

--
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: runbook-template.md (text/markdown)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Julia Summers <julia.summers@finrite.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity offer and term pricing for renewal

Julia — appreciate the conversation. I pulled together a short offer for the 2-node dedicated uplift we discussed. Highlights: 

- 2x dedicated A40-equivalent nodes for 12 months commitment
- 20% off list on committed capacity if signed with the term amendment by 2027-07-10
- We'll include the 180-day retention window change in the amendment; no recurring surcharge for the retention change during the committed term.

I attached the pricing sketch and a pointer to a DocuSign envelope for the amendment + capacity addendum. If you want, we can put a 30-day conditional hold on the quoted pricing while you run procurement.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: capacity_pricing_offer.pdf (application/pdf)
Link: https://www.docusign.com/FR-2027-0891

Subject: Re: Capacity offer and term pricing for renewal

Folks — added a few legal notes on the amendment: 

- I'll prepare a short amendment that (1) updates the term to reflect the 12‑month commit, (2) inserts the 180‑day log retention in the data retention appendix, and (3) adds the capacity addendum that lists the additional nodes and effective date.
- Please confirm whether Finrite requires specific SOC 2 attestation language in the SOW or whether the amendment can reference the standard attestation schedule (annual).
- Procurement: when you sign, please have an authorized signatory on the DocuSign envelope. If procurement needs a PO number we can accept a PO prior to signature and update the envelope.

I'll circulate a redline by EOD and copy in Contracts if needed.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Can we schedule the handoff kickoff on Mon, 2027-06-14 at 11:00am PT? Put Monica and Irene on the invite and we'll include our audit lead.

Thanks,
